description: Capabilities that a server may support. Known capabilities are defined here, in this schema, but this is not a closed set: any server can define its own, additional capabilities.

completions.description: Present if the server supports argument autocompletion suggestions.

experimental.description: Experimental, non-standard capabilities that the server supports.

logging.description: Present if the server supports sending log messages to the client.

prompts.description: Present if the server offers any prompt templates.

listChanged.description: Whether this server supports notifications for changes to the prompt list.

resources.description: Present if the server offers any resources to read.

listChanged.description: Whether this server supports notifications for changes to the resource list.

subscribe.description: Whether this server supports subscribing to resource updates.

tasks.description: Present if the server supports task-augmented requests.

requests.description: Specifies which request types can be augmented with tasks.

call.description: Whether the server supports task-augmented tools/call requests.

tools.description: Present if the server offers any tools to call.

listChanged.description: Whether this server supports notifications for changes to the tool list.
